candidate.name: Intuned
candidate.one_liner: Build and run reliable browser automations as code

provenance.title: Launch HN: Intuned (YC S22) – Build and run reliable browser automations as code

facts.statement: Intuned is a platform for building, deploying, and maintaining browser automations as code.
facts.value: Build and run reliable browser automations as code

facts.statement: Customers primarily use Intuned AI agent to automate websites that don't expose APIs for tasks like scraping data, pulling reports, and submitting forms.
In late 2024, stronger AI models like Claude Code and Codex enabled Intuned to pivot from rigid pipelines to a more open-ended coding agent approach.
Intuned is a managed runtime platform running browser automation code with an integrated AI agent that debug and maintain the automation code.
The Intuned platform captures context of every automation run including parameters, results, traces, and logs for debugging and self-healing.
Intuned Agent generates and maintains integration code via reverse-engineered network calls or browser automation and runs it at scale with authentication, captcha solving, and observability.
facts.value: Build reliable integrations for services with no APIs

facts.statement: Intuned builds integrations for services that do not have APIs by either copying the service's network calls or automating a browser, running these integrations at scale with handling of login, captchas, and monitoring.

Intuned supports use cases including scrapers to extract data from websites, crawlers to navigate and collect data across many pages, back-office automation for data entry and form submissions, AI-powered automations, managed integrations, data migration, and AI agents using various AI frameworks.

Intuned Agent is the first AI agent designed to build and maintain scrapers generating Playwright code, with features to enable self-healing and support authenticated scrapers managing authentication state.
Intuned offers stealth mode featuring anti-detection, proxies, and captcha solving built in for crawlers and AI automations.
Intuned automates back-office workflows in CRMs, vendor portals, admin panels, and legacy systems with authenticated operations, reliable execution, and monitoring.
Intuned runs browser and network automations as deterministic scripts, AI-driven automations, crawlers, or any combination, using any framework in TypeScript or Python.
Intuned maintains a GitHub repository called 'cookbook' with examples for building browser automations using Intuned, primarily in Python.
The Intuned GitHub account is an organization account.
The Intuned/cookbook GitHub repository has 30 stars as of 2026-08-23.
The Intuned/cookbook GitHub repository was last pushed to on 2026-08-21.
The Intuned/cookbook GitHub repository was created on 2025-12-02.
Intuned offers a free tier with trial credits for initial automations, enabling self-service sign-up and usage without requiring contact with sales.
Intuned publishes pricing plans on their website including a Free plan at $0/month, Developer at $25/month, Startup at $120/month, and an Enterprise plan with custom pricing.
The Free plan includes 3 compute hours, 5 API machines, 10 job runs, $5 trial AI credit, advanced stealth mode, and 7-day data retention.
The Developer plan includes 100 compute hours, 25 API machines, 100 job runs, $5 AI credit, access to large and XL machines, advanced stealth mode, and 30-day data retention for $25 per month.
The Startup plan includes 500 compute hours, 100 API machines, 400 job runs, $40 AI credit, access to large and XL machines, advanced stealth mode, and 30-day data retention for $120 per month.
The Enterprise plan offers custom compute and machine limits, volume pricing, SSO/SAML, advanced access controls, dedicated support, custom data retention and regions.
Faisal and Ahmad are founders of Intuned, as stated by themselves on Hacker News.
Faisal has a background at UiPath, contributing to the product pivot in early 2024.
